'''Billy Beuhler''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2002 Coruscant Regionals]] on 26 May 2002 with LS HB-less HB (Hidden Base deck without Hidden Base), according to Michael Robinson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3695">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-27-mrobs-coruscant-regionals-5-26d3695/ mrobs-coruscant-regionals-5-26], DeckTech (Michael "Bobafett465" Robinson, 27 May 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-27-mrobs-coruscant-regionals-5-26d3695/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
